entities.name: Query Pmp3 proteolipid
observations: 57 aa protein with high hydrophobicity (GRAVY 1.3263), consistent with an integral membrane proteolipid.
Exact sequence match to UniProt Q4WYA5, annotated as plasma membrane proteolipid 3 in Aspergillus fumigatus.
Contains Pfam Pmp3 domain PF01679.23 spanning residues 7–55.
Curated homolog annotations place the protein in the cell/plasma membrane and suggest a role in membrane-potential regulation, possibly via proton leak.

entities.name: Q4WYA5
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein Plasma membrane proteolipid 3 from Aspergillus fumigatus; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated localization: cell membrane; single-pass membrane protein.
Annotated function: participates in regulation of membrane potential and could mediate proton leak by similarity.
